top_choice_rationale: Sequencing by synthesis rests on identifiable chemistry (reversible 3'-blocked fluorescent nucleotides, polymerase incorporation, cleavable linkers, clonal surface readout), has been independently reproduced at scale for nearly two decades, and made mutation spectra and replication-error signatures quantitatively measurable. The two-name Balasubramanian-Klenerman allocation with a citation limited to the reversible-terminator route is defensible, though Rothberg, Mayer and Ju credit claims remain a real objection. P001 is a close second with the cleanest attribution and a distinct mechanism from the 2010 C-C prize; P004 follows as sound science with unresolved credit.
